name: Overlapping Community Detection by k-Clique Percolation
shortfall_explanation: The current contract is k-clique percolation. Generic overlapping community models and ordinary Louvain/Leiden are not equivalent; no matching public GPU artifact was verified.
limitation_notes: A matching input variant can qualify without supporting every optional mode. Missing canonical adapters and absent runtime validation remain separate from research collection eligibility.
